Percentages say where you are. ClaudePace says where you're heading.

A bar at 31% looks fine — until you notice it's only day two. ClaudePace compares your usage with the time that has passed, projects the rest of the window and gives you a date: when the limit runs out, or how much you'll have left at reset.

Small app. Useful answers.

Questions

Is ClaudePace made by Anthropic?

No. ClaudePace is an independent app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. It reads the same usage numbers Claude shows you, using your own login.

Which plans does it work with?

Claude Pro and Max subscriptions, as long as you're signed in to Claude Code on the same Mac.

Does it use up my limit?

No. It only asks how much you've used — it never sends prompts to Claude.

How accurate is the forecast?

It assumes you keep your current pace for the rest of the window. Early in a window it holds back until there's enough data. Treat it like a fuel gauge: very good at warning you, not a guarantee.

Windows or Linux?

Not yet — ClaudePace is a native Mac app.
